ns2:section.sectionText: Students in this remote online section will be expected to attend the class synchronously on Zoom on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 12:30 to 1:50 pm CST. There will be no asynchronous participation option for this class. Therefore, it is recommended that students ensure their computers and internet connections meet the minimum Zoom system requirements. A small kit of resources to support some in-class demonstrations will be made available to students, and a pick-up location will be determined. Day1Access course materials cost $68.24. For more information see https://go.illinois.edu/Day1Access.
